prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Jason D's Vision Spain location master source, wide landscape
Primary request: Create an original photorealistic artistic interpretation of Puerta de Santa María and the old town of Hondarribia, Spain, at 24 September 2026 02:30 Europe/Madrid.
Scene/backdrop: Public lower approach immediately southeast of the gate, eye-level looking northwest through the principal old-town entrance toward rising Kale Nagusia.
Subject and geometry: simple pale-ochre stone arch under the carved Hondarribia city coat of arms, thick defensive wall, compact Santa María turret to the left, cobbled uphill street and narrow historic Basque façades beyond. The gate is the unmistakable focal landmark, with realistic scale and permanent surroundings.
Style/medium: highly realistic contemporary travel photography aesthetic, restrained documentary naturalism, believable masonry and street texture, no fantasy.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9-friendly source with generous sky and side margins, complete gate and wall visible, central subject also suitable for a portrait crop.
Lighting/mood: deep night under model-clear conditions, 17.7°C, 3% cloud, dry, light wind. Subtle warm existing street-level ambient light only; dark blue-black sky. Do not assert or dramatize any illumination schedule.
Constraints: no visible people, cars, event decorations, flags, logos, readable signs, moon, stars, wet pavement, rain, text, caption, signature, watermark, or border. No invented towers or church skyline behind the gate.
prompts.prompt-r2.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected Jason D's Vision Spain location master source
Primary request: Correct only the architecture of Puerta de Santa María, Hondarribia, to the documented surviving form.
Required correction: remove the entire invented grand triangular pediment, classical pilasters, finials, and monumental triumphal-gate ornament. Replace them with the real restrained surviving gate: one simple broad segmental voussoired stone arch cut directly through the rough defensive wall, with the carved 1694 Hondarribia city coat of arms mounted immediately above the arch on the wall. Keep the compact round Santa María turret to the left, but make it a plain 16th-century defensive cubo rather than an ornate watchtower.
Preserve exactly: the wide framing, empty cobbled approach, uphill old-town street visible through the arch, surrounding rough masonry walls, deep clear night, realistic warm street-level ambient light, and all other scene content.
Constraints: no people, cars, flags, signs, moon, stars, wet pavement, text, caption, signature, watermark, or border. Do not add any new towers, chapel façade, pediment, or decorative gateway structure.
